book.name: MARKUS
book.title: MARKUS Markus nu pasa mayenu Yesus Kristus tuku kuyarna

content: Yesus nu taŋgo wai pagriŋganu wakeina
Yesus nu maŋ kusem wandek sinam kina. Sinam taŋge taŋgo ande wai kummba pagriŋganu ŋak minna.
Farisi nane nu kusem ait mbolŋge taŋgo wakeiwa le pasa mbolŋge palmbim tuku nu kulatka minnaig le
nu taŋgo wainu kummba pagriŋganu ŋak ta sana: Ne ilmba ŋgamu teŋge tiŋga ŋgina.
Taŋakina sulumba Yesus ndek nane saniŋgina: Sine siŋgine tukul dubika kusem ait mbolŋge sine afu mbolŋge wam mayebe ko ŋayobe? Ande wakeibe ko balebe ŋga kusnaniŋgina le nane maninok minnaig.
Taŋanaig le Yesus nu gubra tumba mbilmbilka nane kaŋgerkina ta nane ŋgamuŋgal kareŋganu ŋak tukunu nu ŋgamuŋgal pitina sulumba taŋgo ta sana: Ne wai kuitka ŋgina le nu wai kuitka wai mayekina.
Taŋana le Farisi mbal pastiŋga mayok ka Herodus dubinaig mbal ndoŋ maŋgurkinaig sulumba Yesus balewam tuku pasa katmba ndin sotinaig.
Nane gudommba Yesus dubimba kinaig
Yesus nuŋe dubiwanu mbal ndoŋ ma ta kusremba Galilea kule kualiŋ tugum kinaig le Galilea mbal gudommba nu dubimba kinaig.
Yudea ma tugu Yerusalem tumbraŋ suŋgo Idumia ma Yordan kule make sim Tirus le Sidon patukŋge tumbraŋ foŋfoŋ ta tuku mbal gudommba Yesus wam ke likina ta ismba nu tugum prowe likinaig.

Nane prowe likinaig mbal Yesus nu guaze taŋgo wakeike likina ta kila tukunu guaze mbal promba nu kirewam tuku muŋgu signaŋginaig le Yesus nu ndek nuŋe dubiwanu mbal saniŋgina: Ye tuku waŋ ande madiwap. Nane gudommba muŋgu signa-signaŋga ye pipkade ŋgina.
Mara mindek bukla ŋaigonu nane Yesus kaŋgermba ka nu tugumŋge bariŋge lika wikaraumba sakanu: Ne Kuate tuku Kiŋo ŋganu le
nu ndek nane miŋge pipniŋmba nu tuku nyu te-mayok ndawaig ŋga saniŋmba minanu.
Yesus nu aposel 12 madiniŋgina
Yesus nu tabe ande poŋgina sulumba nuŋe nzalimbi taŋgo wike likina le nane ndek nu tugum pronaig.
Taŋanaig le nu nane ŋgamukŋge taŋgo 12 nu ndoŋ minam tuku madiniŋgina. Nu nane kukulniŋguwa le nuŋe pasa kuklimba
bukla pitaikam tuku saŋgri tam tuku ŋga nu nane madiniŋgina.
Nane tuku nyu kat naŋgine ta teŋenmba. Ande Simon Yesusŋge nyu kitek Petrus ŋgina.
Ande Yakobus nu Sebedeus tuku kiŋo nuŋe. Ande Yohanus nu Yakobus tuku maib nuŋe. (Nale ar ta Yesus nyu ande Boanesis ŋgina. Nyu ta tugunu Kuaila).
Nane afu Andreus, Filipus, Bartolomeus, Mateus, Tomas. Ande Yakobus nu Alfeus tuku kiŋo nuŋe. Ande Tadeus. Ande Simon mape nyu nuŋe Selot.
Ande Yudas Iskariotnu. Ŋgumneŋga nu Yesus tuku kupet taŋgo mayok kina.
Yesus nu Belsebul ndoŋ piro tuma ŋginaig
Kile Yesus nu tiŋga ka wande mbol kina ta nane gudommba maŋ pro maŋgurkinaig le Yesus nane isukusam mata kumuŋ kuga.
Yesus tuku ndare tuma wam ta ismba nu itilu ŋginŋgankate ŋga idusmba nane nu tam kinaig.

Kile kusem pasa bitekŋganu mbal afu Yerusalemŋge ndekinaig ta ndek sakinaig: A ... bukla Belsebulŋge nu tate. Bukla kame tuku gabat Belsebulŋge saŋgri ta tuwit le nu bukla pitaike likate ŋga sakinaig.
Taŋakinaig le Yesus nu ndek te yalpe ŋga yaba pasa afu nane saniŋgina sulumba sakina: Satan nu nuŋe mbal pitaikam kumuŋ e?
Gabat suŋgo ande tuku kuasmbi nane pur yimyamka naŋgine naŋgine kame buwaig ta nane saŋgri ŋak minam kumuŋ kuga.
Wande ande tuku mbal nane pur yimyamka naŋgine naŋgine kame buwaig ta nane mata saŋgri ŋak minam kumuŋ kuga.
Taŋamba ndo Satan nu nuŋe mbal pitaika pur yimyamka nane ndoŋ kame bute kande nu mata saŋgri ŋak mine ndaka ŋgisikam bafute kande.
Taŋgo saŋgrinu ande nuŋe wande kulatkate ta ande pro nu tuku agaŋ ndende kuayaram kumuŋ kuga. Nu taŋgo saŋgrinu te-ibeŋmba nu ndalekuwa sulumba ndo agaŋ ndende kilam kumuŋ.
Ye siŋka satiŋgamŋgit. Taŋgo tuku une maŋau tumail pan maŋau ta ŋakmba Kuate nu sauka gilaiŋgate tuku.
Ande nu Tukul Guwa tumail pante ta Kuate nu mbar ta sauka gilaiŋge nda. Nu mbolŋge minmba minamŋgat ŋgina.
Nane Yesus nu bukla ŋak ŋginaig tukunu nu taŋamba nane riroŋ pasa niŋgina.
Yesus ina mambo kat nuŋe pronaig
Kile Yesus ina nuŋe mambo kat nuŋe ndoŋ nane pro wande tugum taŋge tiŋga pasa pilnaig le
nane maŋgur Yesus te-ŋgamumba minnaig ta nane nu sanaig: Ina naŋe mambo kat naŋe kulim kat naŋe nane pro kilimŋge tiŋga ne kusnaŋgade ŋginaig.
Taŋakinaig le Yesus nu nane saniŋgina: Tane yiŋe ina yiŋe maib kame tuku sayade e ŋgina sulumba
nu mbilka nane nu tugumŋge minyokinaig mbal ta saniŋmba sakina: Mbal te yiŋe ina yiŋe mambo kame taŋaŋ minig.
Ima nu Kuate tuku nzali dubite ta nu yiŋe maib yiŋe kulim yiŋe ina taŋaŋ minit ŋga saniŋgina.
